title: Bedtime Routine Completion Before School Nights
dataSources: Nanit sleep sessions (`nanit:sleep`), Hatch routines (`hatch:routine`), school calendar events (`schoolcalendar:event`), allowance transactions (`allowance:txn`), and kid screen usage (`screentime:usage`).
app: Family-routine telemetry from Nanit sleep exports, Hatch routine data, school calendars, allowance and chore apps, and Apple Screen Time sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hatch:routine
| search school_night=true routine_type=bedtime
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(status="complete")) as successful by _time child_name
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for bedtime routines before school nights by child.
value: Completion before school nights is one of the clearest ways to measure whether the evening system is actually holding together.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for bedtime routines before school nights events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for bedtime routines before school nights by child.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how often bedtime routines before school nights works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
